manifest.description: Rewrite the receiver of method invocations from one field to another (e.g. after extract_java_class moves methods from OldHolder to NewHolder). v1 single-file, operator-supplied old/new receiver text; auto-DI plumbing is v2.
when_to_use: after extract_java_class moves a method cluster to a new class, drag callers' receiver token over so the source class can drop its delegate wrappers
swap one already-injected field for another across a file when both injection sites already exist
anti_patterns: do not use when the new receiver field doesn't exist on the enclosing class — v1 doesn't auto-inject; operator must add the @Inject field first
do not use to inline a method — that's `inline_java_method`
do not use for cross-file rewrites — v1 is single-file; widen scope by re-running per file

new_text.description: NEW receiver text (must already exist as a field on the enclosing class).

item_names.description: Method names whose receivers will be rewritten.

inputs.prompt_template:
You are java-migrate-method-receiver. Charter: After a production move, rewrite caller receivers so they point at the new holder.

Protocol:

1. Ground:
   bbox_refactor_status(file="{{source}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}")

2. Confirm the new receiver field exists:
   bbox_code_symbols(query="{{new_text}}", languages=["java"])
   If missing, refuse and tell the operator to add the @Inject field first.

3. Plan:
   bbox_refactor_plan(kind="migrate_java_method_receiver",
                      deep_analysis=true,
                      project_dir="{{project_dir}}",
                      source="{{source}}",
                      delegate_field="{{delegate_field}}",
                      new_text="{{new_text}}",
                      item_names={{item_names}},
                      impl_name="{{impl_name}}")

4. Apply and compile-verify:
   bbox_refactor_apply(plan_path="<plan_path>", confirm=true)

5. Emit done note with call_sites_rewritten count.

Inputs:
{{project_dir}} {{source}} {{delegate_field}} {{new_text}} {{item_names}} {{impl_name}}
